articles.full_text:
उत्तराखंड से मानसून की शनिवार को विदाई की संभावना , तापमान में वृद्धि और कोहरे का अनुमान
अगले 24 घंटों में पूरे उत्तराखंड से दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून की विदाई के लिए परिस्थितियां अनुकूल हैं, जिससे प्रदेश में मौसम ...और पढ़ें
समय कम है?
जानिए मुख्य बातें और खबर का सार एक नजर में
जागरण संवाददाता, देहरादून। उत्तराखंड में दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून की विदाई के लिए परिस्थितियां अनुकूल बन गई हैं। मौसम विभाग के अनुसार अगले 24 घंटे के दौरान प्रदेश के संपूर्ण हिस्सों से मानसून के प्रस्थान कर सकता है। इसके साथ ही शनिवार को राज्यभर में मौसम शुष्क रहने की संभावना है।
प्रदेश में बीते कुछ दिनों से मौसम पूरी तरह शुष्क बना हुआ है। दिन के समय तेज धूप निकलने के कारण अधिकतम तापमान में बढ़ोतरी हुई है और लोगों को अक्टूबर में भी गर्मी व उमस का अहसास हो रहा है।
मौसम विभाग के अनुसार कई स्थानों पर अधिकतम तापमान सामान्य से दो से तीन डिग्री सेल्सियस अधिक दर्ज किया जा रहा है। मौसम विभाग ने शनिवार को प्रदेश के मैदानी क्षेत्रों में कहीं-कहीं छिछले से मध्यम कोहरा छाने की संभावना जताई है।
हालांकि, अधिकांश क्षेत्रों में मौसम शुष्क रहने का अनुमान है। मानसून की विदाई के बाद अगले कुछ दिनों में अधिकतम तापमान में हल्की गिरावट आने की संभावना है।
हालांकि, मौसम पूरी तरह शुष्क नहीं रहने वाला है। आगामी बुधवार को प्रदेश में फिर वर्षा के आसार बन रहे हैं। मौसम में बदलाव के साथ सुबह और रात के तापमान में अंतर बढ़ने की संभावना है।
शनिवार का अनुमानित तापमान

Rabat – Morocco’s General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) said a heatwave and thunderstorms will affect several provinces across the country.
Temperatures will range between 36 and 40 degrees Celsius and will affect the provinces of Taroudant, Oued E-Dahab, Es-Semara, Boujdour, Laayoune and Aousserd from Friday to Sunday.
The orange-level weather alert also forecasts thunderstorms of between 20 and 30 millimeters with a risk of hail and wind during storms from 1 p.m. to 11 p.m. today. This weather will specifically potentially hit the provinces of Al Haouz, Ifrane, Azilal, and Rehamna.
The same weather is also expected in Boulemane, Marrakech, El Kelaa Sraghna, Khenifra, Chichaoua and Sefrou.
On Thursday, the weather office also said it expects temperatures ranging between 36 and 42 degrees in southern provinces through Sunday, and thunderstorms producing 20 to 25 millimeters of rainfall in other provinces like Taourirt, Al Haouz, Tata, Guercif, Sefrou and Boulemane.

articles.full_text:
October heat wave could break daily records
Published 8:53 am Friday, October 2, 2026
So much for autumn.
In the 10 days since the equinox on Sept. 22, the high temperature at the Baker City Airport has been above average on six.
And that’s just the start.
The real heat is yet to come.
The National Weather Service is forecasting the early fall heat wave to continue through at least Oct. 8.
Although no daily high temperature records have been set so far, that could change.
This stretch of summer-like weather is due to an atmospheric pattern more typical of July than October, with a massive ridge of high pressure, centered near the Four Corners, dominating weather across much of the West.
The high of 75 degrees on Thursday, Oct. 1, at the Baker City Airport, although about 4 degrees above average, is likely to be the coolest day for at least the next week.
The National Weather Service is predicting highs in the 80s through at least Oct. 8.
The best chance to break a record looks to be Monday, Oct. 5.
This is the second early October hot spell in the past two years. In October 2024 the temperature was above average at the airport on each of the month’s first 15 days, and the temperature topped 80 degrees on seven days.
The 2024 heat wave set record highs of 81 on Oct. 13, 86 on Oct. 14 and 81 on Oct. 15, and tied records on Oct. 4 (86) and Oct. 7 (84).
Following are forecast highs for each day, followed by the record high and the year it was set.
• Oct. 2: forecast high 81 — record high 89, set in 2010
• Oct. 3: forecast high 81 — record high 87, set in 1988
• Oct. 4: forecast high 85 — record high 86, set in 1993 and tied in 2024
• Oct. 5: forecast high 85 — record high 84, set in 1979
• Oct. 6: forecast high 80 — record high 87, set in 1980
• Oct. 7: forecast high 80 — record high 84, set in 1980 and tied in 2024
• Oct. 8: forecast high 80 — record high 88, set in 2024
Statistically, October is one of the more dramatic transition months when it comes to temperatures.
The average high on Oct. 1 is 71, dropping 20 degrees, to 51, on Nov. 1.
By contrast, the average high dips by just 11 degrees during November, to 40 on Dec. 1, and by 9 degrees during December, to an average high of 31 on Jan. 1.
The biggest change in the opposite direction is during June, when the average high temperature climbs from 70 to 81.

articles.title: IPO fundraising reaches all-time high of Rs 94,205 crore in H1FY27, NSE drives momentum - tribuneindia.com
articles.search_term: ("mercury soars" OR "mercury crosses" OR "temperature soars" OR "record temperature" OR "all-time high" OR "degrees Celsius" OR "maximum temperature" OR "hottest day" OR "temperature crosses 40" OR "temperature crosses 45" OR "temperature likely to rise") Andaman and Nicobar Islands
articles.full_text:
Fundraising via primary board initial public offerings (IPOs) achieved a record Rs 94,205 crore in the initial half (H1) of financial year (FY) 2027, driven by a surge in large-ticket issues such as the Rs 22,563-crore offering from the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE), as per data from Prime Database.
A total of 78 companies accessed the main board from April to September, raising 35 per cent more than the Rs 69,533 crore gathered by 65 IPOs in the same timeframe of FY26. The latest figure represents the highest first-half IPO activity ever recorded, even with a slow beginning to the financial year and fluctuations in the secondary market.
The fundraising activity was focused on a small number of significant offerings. Apart from NSE, SBI Funds Management secured Rs 9,795 crore, whereas Manipal Health Enterprises gathered Rs 9,275 crore during this timeframe.
The pipeline indicates that activity in the primary market may continue to be high in the upcoming months. As per Prime Database, 145 firms with planned issues amounting to approximately Rs 2.78 lakh crore have already gained approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi). An additional 102 firms, aiming to generate around Rs 1.87 lakh crore, are pending regulatory clearance.
Including SME IPOs, total IPO fundraising exceeded the Rs 1 lakh crore threshold in H1FY27, up from Rs 76,330 crore during the same timeframe last year.
In total, public equity fundraising, which encompasses IPOs, SME issues, institutional placements, and fundraising via infrastructure and real estate investment trusts, increased by 75 percent, reaching a record Rs 2.43 lakh crore over the six-month period.
Investor involvement also stayed robust in the primary market. Out of the 64 IPOs with available subscription data, 42 attracted bids that surpassed 10 times the number of shares being offered. Up to 25 issues were subscribed to over 50 times.
The performance of listings also enhanced in comparison to the prior year. The typical listing increases for the 64 IPOs, determined by the difference between the issue price and the closing price on the listing day, was 19 percent in H1FY27, in contrast to 7 percent during the first half of FY26.
The interplay of a solid IPO pipeline, strong investor interest, and enhanced listing outcomes indicate ongoing activity in the primary market, despite companies being cautious about the overall equity market conditions.
